network.coverage_note: This is a retail e-commerce site for an online health/natural products store (The Health Store, operated by Medina Healthcare Ltd.) selling supplements, cosmetics, hygiene and food products in Malta. No named owner, manager, or staff member appears anywhere in the evidence (only a general info email/phone and two customer testimonials who are not staff), so no contact could be identified. There is also no mention of Erasmus+, international partners, or additional campuses beyond the single head office address in Birkirkara.
